description: This file defines the UploadedFile class in the GuzzleHttp\Psr7 namespace, implementing the UploadedFileInterface. It manages uploaded file metadata and operations such as validation, stream handling, and moving files to target locations, which is typical for an upload handling component.

classes.name: UploadedFile
classes.description: Represents an uploaded file, providing mechanisms to access file data, metadata, and perform file operations such as moving the uploaded file to a new location.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the UploadedFile object with stream or file, size, error status, and optional client filename and media type.

methods.name: getStream
methods.description: Returns a stream representing the uploaded file's data.

methods.name: moveTo
methods.description: Moves the uploaded file to a new location specified by targetPath.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the uploaded file if available.

methods.name: getError
methods.description: Returns the error status of the upload.

methods.name: getClientFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename provided by the client, if available.

methods.name: getClientMediaType
methods.description: Returns the media type provided by the client, if available.
